title: Project gate
responsibility: Offer local workspace actions and the paired-phone project list, with an accessible logo and optional device settings.

inputs.name: ProjectGate.available
inputs.description: Whether this runtime has a bridge. With busy it enables the Open project button (rendered only while local is true); while local is true, false shows the read-only browser-preview hint, and true offers the New project button and the Project Overview link. It never disables recent-project choices, which depend only on busy.

inputs.name: ProjectGate.local
inputs.description: Whether projects are opened on this device; defaults to true. False is for a phone, whose projects are those of a computer: it hides the action row, uses the computer wording for the empty Recent projects line, labels non-shared projects without a root On your computer, and renders the children inline.

inputs.name: ProjectGate.overview
inputs.description: Shows the Project Overview link in the Recent projects header when a paired phone can offer it; the desktop app (available and local) always shows it.

inputs.name: ProjectGate.busy
inputs.description: Whether a project operation is in progress. While it is true, the local Open project button (rendered only when local is true) is disabled, has aria-busy set and reads Opening project…, and every recent-project button is disabled.

inputs.name: ProjectGate.open
inputs.description: Required callback run when the local Open project button is clicked; that button is rendered only while local is true and is enabled only while available is true and busy is false. The component does not choose a folder itself or catch callback failures.

inputs.name: ProjectGate.projects
inputs.description: Optional recent-project choices, defaulting to []; each supplies id, name, kind ('local' or 'shared') and optional root. Shared entries are labeled Shared project, and other entries show their root or else their device location (On this device, or On your computer when local is false).

inputs.name: ProjectGate.choose
inputs.description: Optional callback receiving a selected recent-project identifier. Defaults to JavaScript undefined (omitted); activating a listed project does nothing when no callback is supplied.

inputs.name: ProjectGate.phone
inputs.description: Optional phone access settings. When given, a quiet hint says to connect a phone by signing in with the same Google account, and its Phone access button opens this snippet in a dialog titled Phone access. Defaults to JavaScript undefined (omitted): no hint and no dialog.

inputs.name: ProjectGate.children
inputs.description: Optional quiet status (a Svelte snippet) rendered after the phone hint: centered and muted on this device, inline when local is false. Defaults to JavaScript undefined (omitted), in which case nothing is rendered.

outputs.name: ProjectGate
outputs.description: A logo labelled Harness, local Open project and New project actions when applicable, and recent projects that can be selected directly. The Project Overview and linked-device actions appear when their runtime supplies them.

errors.name: Caller callback or content error
errors.description: Errors thrown by the supplied open and choose callbacks, or by the children snippet, propagate unhandled when the callback is invoked or the snippet is rendered; this component provides no error boundary.
